chapters.title: Valley of Dragons
chapters.summary: Introduces the peaceful coexistence of humans, elves, and dragons and the complementary strengths that sustain the valley.

chapters.title: Attack of the Dark God
chapters.summary: The Dark God invades with a layered army. Elves and dragons form the Dragon Rider Knights; Gawain rescues two-year-old Alaric after his village is destroyed.

chapters.title: Alaric
chapters.summary: Alaric grows up in a loving adoptive family during a fragile peace and develops a protective, rather than revenge-driven, desire to join the defenders.

chapters.title: The Decision
chapters.summary: On his sixteenth birthday Alaric decides to pursue the path of a dragon rider and leaves his village with his adoptive family's blessing.

chapters.title: River City
chapters.summary: Alaric works in caravan trade, blacksmithing, and weaponsmithing; religious counsel sends him to Silverdale, where he meets Eloran.

chapters.title: Forest City
chapters.summary: Alaric enters elven society, learns plantsmithing from Eloran, and receives combat training from retired Dragon Rider Knight Eryndor.

chapters.title: Battle of Greystone Pass
chapters.summary: As Kael's squire, Alaric joins the defense against Lich King Mortag. He disrupts a lethal spell, is grievously wounded, survives through Gawain's healing, and is knighted as the first human Dragon Rider Knight.

chapters.title: Champion
chapters.summary: Alaric mentors recruits, bonds with the sapphire-blue dragon Vaelor, defends his home region, reconnects with his village, and at twenty-eight becomes a paladin after Galahad retires.

chapters.title: Paladin
chapters.summary: A vision warns Alaric that passive defense will end in catastrophe. In the Forest of Faron, the Lady of the Lake gives him the Sword of the Dawn, capable of killing the Dark God.

chapters.title: Evil's Lair
chapters.summary: The Dragon Rider Knights launch a direct assault on Mount Doom. A strike team penetrates the firestorm, reaches the throne room, and Alaric kills the Dark God with the Sword of the Dawn.
